name: Sakuya Naomasa
source:
[Protagonist]
The protagonist of the main story. After falling for the seductive ploys of the ship’s navigators, he ends up being dragged aboard the *Albatross* as a second mate. 

Compared to the rest of the crew, he is relatively sensible—but in reality, he’s a troublesome fellow prone to extreme manic-depressive swings. 

In his manic phases, he fancies himself an invincible man of the sea (though his confidence is entirely baseless, and he’s actually pathetically weak). 

In his depressive phases, he becomes a sluggish, insufferable lump—so weighed down by gravity itself that he’s rendered completely immobile. In short, he’s a lecherous, cowardly, lazy, and utterly hopeless human being. 

He is very direct about his sexual desires; whenever the ship pulls into port, he lets out a whoop and heads straight off to "pursue romance" with the ladies at the local "teahouse" (a euphemism, of course). 

That said, he actually prefers booze to women—alcohol always takes top priority. He ended up on the *Albatross* through a series of vague, cascading events, but he harbors a typical "good-for-nothing" dream: he hopes to reach some land where he can spend his days drinking and having a grand, carefree time. 

Since this ship visits all sorts of different countries, he’s convinced that such a place must surely exist somewhere.
